design_directive: DECISION: Use Option C. Replace the legacy row-heavy cards with evidence-qualified contracts; do not preserve their shape.
PHARMACY CARD: render only display_name, first source-backed facility location, concise source-backed services summary, and an evidence line with source classes plus last_researched_date.
PHARMACY ELIGIBILITY: require source-backed nonempty location and services plus a cited evidence summary; 75 of 90 qualify now.
Do not render the 15 ineligible pharmacies in the default card grid; keep their source records available for later research/detail use.
DROP FROM PHARMACY CARDS: provider relationships, consumer price, rating, additive evidence, GLP medication relevance, state coverage, legal identity, 503A/503B pathway, and regulatory actions.
Keep dropped pharmacy facts on detail/evidence pages only when the exact field is source-backed.
PROVIDER CARD: render only display_name, meds_offered, source-reported total_monthly_cost, and source-reported cancellation.
PROVIDER ELIGIBILITY: require all four core fields; 35 of 38 qualify. Exclude mydrhank, breeze-meds-review, and care-bare-rx-glp1-review from the default card grid.
Move included costs, shipping, state coverage, and wait time to provider detail pages; drop insurance and eligibility from cards.
DOSE PRICING: remove every dose-tier grid from cards. Only 11 of 542 slots are sourceable (2.0%).
Render exact dose tiers only on provider detail pages when dose_pricing.status=SOURCE_REPORTED_PER_DOSE; otherwise render nothing.
Never render UNKNOWN_NO_SOURCE, legacy placeholder copy, blank rows, empty cells, or reserved placeholder space.
Never substitute generic filler. A record missing a required core field is ineligible for the default card grid.
Keep source URL and capture date attached to every fact; tag every numeric MEASURED, SOURCE-REPORTED, or ESTIMATED. No medical claims.
